_metadata.name: Late Raw Material Delivery
_metadata.description: Simulates a 24-hour delay in receiving castings/forgings for a critical Tier-1 order, forcing the scheduler to pull alternative work forward to prevent idle spindle time.

events.notes: Raw material supplier delayed delivery of FAM_A castings. Operation 1 (CNC Lathe) for ORD-104 cannot begin until Tuesday 06:00. Other jobs must be pulled forward to utilize LATHE capacity.
